selection_rules.rule: per-tick compare over server-reachable candidates for the event; serve newest game state. Defaults: MLB=statsapi, NHL=api-web, CFB/NFL/NCAAB/WNBA/MLS/NWSL/UFC/PGA=espn-core, NBA=espn-core (stats.nba.com blocked), fallback=CBS via cloud browser. Kalshi price = always-on secondary signal during exposure windows.
espn-site scoreboard 2s tick primary (CORS *, odds inline), polymarket-gamma 2s, kalshi via allorigins 5s honesty-dimmed (no CORS). Per-tick freshness arbitration identical to sandbox.

relay off the freshest source per tick with source named; frozen-field reads (clock) follow drives.current.plays over status.displayClock; a source stuck >4min while another advances = stale, auto-failover, report the switch.

freshness-provability is a selection input: a feed that can PROVE freshness (event timestamps) outranks a same-speed feed that cannot, because failover decisions need measured evidence not vibes. MLB: statsapi is both fastest AND provable = permanent rank 1. NHL/CFB: serve official/ESPN but mark freshness best-effort; the 4-min field-freeze rule is the failover trigger there.

urf_integration: feed_select.py runs urf.decide on every source-selection change: C (freshness evidence measured=3, assumed=1), F (endpoint reachable now=3), R (read-only=1), U (unmeasured freshness=2 -> PROBE = measure before serving), V (user-facing correctness=3), CE (new feed cataloged=2). Selection CHANGES (failover) log to urf_decisions.jsonl; every registry entry marked verified carries its evidence string - unverified entries are hypotheses for the registry scout, never served as truth.
